label: neiso 35 weather floor
definition: Measured-schedule keeper carrying the new NEISO dual-limb temperature-correlated reliability floor: CT_PEAKER held online on hot summer evenings (hot limb, TMAX, slope 0.037/degC, cap 0.48) and the lone COAL + ST_GAS units held online in winter cold snaps (cold limb, TMIN, slope 0.033/degC), coefficients regressed from measured CAMPD CF vs NEISO load-weighted TMAX/TMIN 2023-2025 (cold-limb rho 0.35/0.40, hot-limb 0.47) — physical temperature->commitment rules, not TWh-residual tunes (docs/neiso-temp-reliability-floor-2026-06.md). Clean fuel mix (gas 59.7 vs EIA-930 59.6; TOTAL 103.9 vs 103.8 TWh, 2024). For the import/export measurement see the priced-interchange probe neiso-34.
